crossRefs.note: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe…
In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display…
In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

translations.web: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.
translations.bsb: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he will succeed in his mission.
translations.kjv: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
translations.asv: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
